profile.name: Abdul Mannan
profile.headline: Thoughtful code.
profile.intro: I build for the web, connect the physical world, and follow the ideas that make me curious.
profile.about:
I’m Abdul, a software engineering student at COMSATS University Islamabad, Sahiwal Campus. I enjoy turning an idea into something people can actually use—from a considered interface to the logic behind it.

My work brings together full-stack development, mobile apps and connected hardware. Lately, I’ve been building GRIDMOTE and exploring AI, automation and the next generation of the web.

projects.title: GRIDMOTE
projects.summary: From a custom interface to a real-world response. A Flutter control app for Arduino.
projects.detail:
GRIDMOTE pairs a custom web layout editor with a Flutter Android app. Layouts are exported as JSON, imported into the app, and used to control an Arduino over Bluetooth.

The project brings together reusable interface components, local project storage, device discovery and live controls. It is an ongoing Mobile Application Development project.

projects.title: A better way to book.
projects.summary: A bus ticket management system built around clear booking flows and structured data.
projects.detail:
A two-person database project covering bus schedules, reservations and ticket records. The work connects an HTML/CSS interface with a SQL database, using XAMPP and phpMyAdmin.

The project explores entity relationships, normalized tables and the path from a database design to a usable booking interface.

projects.title: Movement becomes direction.
projects.summary: A gesture-controlled robotic car that translates hand movement into physical motion.
projects.detail:
A collaborative hardware project exploring a gesture-driven interface. An MPU6050 motion sensor captures movement, with ESP32-based control and wireless communication connecting the transmitter to the car.

The focus is the complete feedback loop: sensing, interpreting movement and controlling hardware.

experience.description: Hands-on work across web development, databases, AI concepts and connected systems. Built with MERN and explored PHP, WordPress and IoT workflows.
